answer: Duplicate identities collapse because cloning requires re-purchasing every bond, making a thousand-fake swarm cost a thousand real stakes. Sybil resistance can be built by tying voting weight to a verifiable staked-cost identity: each agent must lock a walnut-sized bond of tokens plus a unique hardware attestation before joining, and reputation only accrues along a single orchard of provenance-tracked contributions.
